senses.label: Shares in tax-farming companies
senses.summary: Investors hold shares in companies contracted to collect taxes and supply the state.
markers: citizens hold shares in companies doing public contracts
hazards: Largely a Republican institution; much reduced under the emperors.

sources.note: Public contracts and the wide participation of citizens in them.

senses.label: Joint-stock company and stock exchange
senses.summary: Shares in a permanent company are bought and sold by strangers on an exchange.
markers: shares are traded continuously between strangers on an exchange

senses.label: Speculative bubbles
senses.summary: Share prices rise far beyond any value on expectation alone, then collapse.
markers: prices rise because buyers expect them to keep rising

senses.label: Modern financial markets
senses.summary: Mass investment through markets and funds; profiting from price movements is ordinary finance.
markers: ordinary people invest savings in markets for returns
profiting from price movements is a normal activity

sources.citation: Growth of mass share ownership and funds in the 20th century
